channel.title: Alan Carr's Picture Slam
channel.desc: Comedian Alan Carr hosts the fun and frantic quiz show where every question is a picture and every picture is worth cash. They could be anything from famous faces, places, products or logos, and teams need to name them all for a Picture Slam. Playing this time are Ian and Liz, a couple from Stoke-on-Trent, friends Arif and Kausar from London, and Rachel and Connor, two friends from Leeds. They battle it out, across four rounds, shouting out answers and building their banks.
